scale: 1 = poor, 3 = acceptable, 5 = excellent (ready for a senior review at a large tech company)

criteria.name: Problem clarity
criteria.question: Is the problem, the user and why-now clear and specific?

criteria.name: Evidence quality
criteria.question: Are claims backed by the transcript or graded sources, with assumptions clearly marked?

criteria.name: Logic and consistency
criteria.question: Do goals, requirements, scores, risks and launch plan agree with each other? No contradictions?

criteria.name: Security and privacy
criteria.question: Are auth, data protection, secrets and LLM risks (prompt injection, data leakage) covered concretely for this product?

criteria.name: Responsible AI
criteria.question: Fairness, safety, transparency, accountability, EU AI Act duties - specific to this product?

criteria.name: Observability
criteria.question: Logs, quality monitoring, cost and latency tracking, alerts, prompt/model versioning?

criteria.name: Explainability
criteria.question: Do users see sources, confidence and limits of AI output?

criteria.name: Performance and scalability
criteria.question: Latency, scale, availability and cost targets that fit the product?

criteria.name: Right-sized plan
criteria.question: Does version 1 test the riskiest assumption with the simplest build, without over-engineering?

criteria.name: Plain language
criteria.question: Short sentences, jargon explained, readable by a non-expert?
